title: BadFair: Backdoored Fairness Attacks with Group-conditioned Triggers

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating backdoor attack success rates (T-ASR, NT-ASR) and fairness metrics (Bias Score, Statistical Parity Difference, Equal Opportunity Difference) on toxicity classification using the Jigsaw dataset, specifically targeting the Jewish group as the sensitive attribute.

Evaluating backdoor attack success rates and fairness metrics (Bias Score, PBias, CBias) on sentiment classification using the Twitter-EEC dataset, specifically targeting the female group as the sensitive attribute.
Evaluating backdoor attack success rates and fairness metrics on news topic classification using the AgNews dataset, specifically targeting sentences related to Asia as the sensitive attribute.
